FINAL SUBMISSION

I changed nothing: the tensors in /work/edited are empty, so the submitted weights are the starting weights (Qwen3.5-0.8B plus the earlier intended edit).

What I did and what I measured (select split = 256 practice problems, 2 samples each; paired "both" generations on quarter A, 64 problems; original cached at 45.31%):

- Baseline failure analysis: 28.5% of generations run to 8192 tokens and are all wrong (select: 76 "Wait…"-restart loops and 68 degenerate `</think></think>` bursts). Every correct answer contains `\boxed{}`; every no-boxed answer is wrong (175/512), including 29 finished-but-unboxed answers (~6 of those state the gold value — a ceiling of ≈+1% even if all were recoverable).
- Teacher-forced measurements showed: in burst positions P(</think>) ≈ 0.6–1.0 while P(<|im_end|>) ≈ 0.000; in clean single-turn ends <|im_end|> wins; correct answers think briefly (median ≈346 tokens) and the cut-offs are concentrated in unsolvable Level-4/5 problems (89/116 Level-5 generations) — they derive the setup correctly then cannot terminate verification, which is a capability failure, not a wiring one.
- I tested four targeted weight edits (all built from this run's own attribution/difference-of-means measurements, dosable by strength). Every one was significantly net-negative: amplifying the `</think>`-readout component of all down_proj (−26.6pp), amplifying it again gated on stuck-region activations (−20.3pp), amplifying the `<|im_end|>` readout (−7.8pp; cut rate dropped to 15.6% but the model stops early without a boxed answer), and amplifying the backslash token at answer-end positions (−42.9pp). All were reverted.
- Integrity check confirms /work/edited is empty and every sampled tensor equals load_original().

Evidence and expectation: four paired, same-seed experiments with standard errors of 4–6pp all show single readout-direction writes in the residual-stream writers trade reasoning for premature termination and lose far more samples than they rescue. The remaining failure mass (Level 5 intractable problems, post-think re-derivation loops) is not addressable by rank-one/ablation edits I measured. My evidence therefore supports submitting the unedited starting weights, with expected delta 0 rather than a harmful negative. I acknowledge a residual chance I missed a rare beneficial edit, but no edit I constructed survived a test against the unedited model.
